title: UI/UX Designer with React.JS / UI/UX Developer
description:
Job Title: UI UX Designers with React.JS Duration: Fulltime Location: Jaipur Experience: 5+ Years 
 We are looking for a UI UX Designer with UI Development experience with React.JS for a role in our office in Jaipur. This is not a plain UX designer role. This role requires good UI development role using React.JS as well. 
 Key Responsibilities UI/UX Design Design intuitive, user-centered web and mobile experiences. Create wireframes, user flows, journey maps, prototypes, and high-fidelity UI designs. Develop and maintain design systems, style guides, and reusable component libraries. Ensure consistency and scalability across digital platforms. Collaborate with developers to ensure pixel-perfect implementation. UX Research Conduct user research, usability testing, heuristic evaluations, and stakeholder interviews. Translate research insights into actionable design improvements. Create personas, empathy maps, and experience maps. Use qualitative and quantitative insights to enhance user journeys. 
 Front-End Development Develop and implement responsive, scalable interfaces using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and React.js. Build reusable React components aligned with design systems. Ensure cross-browser compatibility, performance optimization, and accessibility compliance. Integrate APIs and dynamic data in collaboration with backend teams. 
 Required Skills & Qualifications 4-5 years of experience in UI/UX design, research, and front-end development. Strong portfolio demonstrating user-centered design solutions and implemented web applications. Proficiency in Figma, Adobe XD, Sketch, or similar tools. Strong hands-on experience with HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript (ES6+), and React.js. Experience in responsive design and modern CSS frameworks (Bootstrap/Tailwind). Solid understanding of usability, accessibility (WCAG), and interaction design principles. Experience in presales/client-facing engagements. Excellent communication and presentation skills. 
 Preferred Qualifications Certification in UX Research, Interaction Design, or Design Thinking (Google UX, NN/g, HFI, etc.). Experience in IT services/consulting environments. Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies. Experience with REST API integration. Knowledge of version control systems (Git). Soft Skills Strong problem-solving mindset. Ability to balance creativity with technical feasibility. Proactive and self-driven approach. Strong collaboration across cross-functional teams. Ability to articulate design decisions with business impact.
